data.notes: Predecessor of Mokka B: Mokka A (2012-2016) and its facelift sold as Mokka X (2016-2019), split because length/width and trunk volume changed. No Mokka before 2012.

corrections.evidence: ADAC Autokatalog Mokka X 1.4 LPG ecoFlex Innovation (Autogasbetrieb) 10/16-07/17: Kofferraumvolumen normal 356 l, fensterhoch 785 l, dachhoch mit umgeklappter Rücksitzbank 1372 l. Same for Active (256902) and 1.4 ECOTEC LPG 06/18-12/18 (291722).
auto motor und sport Testdaten Mokka 1.6 Edition (04/2013): Breite zwischen Radkästen 1000 mm (Messwert ams, same page as the 695 mm Ladekantenhöhe already used). Not a manufacturer figure.

missing.detail: Mokka A (J13): 1.6 CDTI ecoFlex Start&Stop 110 PS (81 kW) Diesel, Frontantrieb, 6-Gang manuell, ADAC Modellzeitraum 06/15-06/16 (e.g. https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/opel/mokka/a/248717). Trunk presumably 362/785/1372 l like other Mokka A variants (not separately verified).

Mokka X: 1.4 (ECOTEC) Turbo Start/Stop 120 PS (88 kW) Benziner, Frontantrieb, Schaltgetriebe, listed by angurten.de German engine list (https://www.angurten.de/is/motoren/1643-opel-mokka-x, ab 20.495 EUR) and fastcarcheck/topgear.nl; no ADAC catalogue entry found to confirm German availability dates. Trunk presumably 356/1372 l (not verified).

verification.notes: Mokka A dimensions 4278x1777x1658, wheelbase 2555 confirmed by ams and encycarpedia; trunk 362/785/1372 confirmed by ADAC (manufacturer data) and Italian/Spanish spec sites; ams test data quotes 356-1372 l and ADAC Gebrauchtwagen-Ratgeber quotes 356 l, but ADAC catalogue/press kit 362 l retained. Mokka X 4275x1781x1658, 2555 mm, 356/785/1372 l confirmed by ADAC (280713 etc.); AutoScout24.at shows 1802 mm width for some trims (likely different measurement), not treated as correction. 1.4 DI Turbo 152 PS 4x4 Automatik ADAC entry runs to 06/18, confirming yearTo 2018. Mokka X production ends 06/19 per ADAC. Sill height 695 mm confirmed by ams.
